name: Heddohon
author: zorcerer
description: Sends each play to Heddohon, whichever app made it, so its listening history and statistics cover every client. Sends an account's scrobble history when that account asks Heddohon to import it.

url.title: Heddohon address
url.description: Where Navidrome reaches Heddohon, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://music.example.com

token.title: Plugin token
token.description: The value of HEDDOHON_NAVIDROME_PLUGIN_TOKEN on the Heddohon server

origin.title: Heddohon's public address
origin.description: Only where the address above is not the one Heddohon is opened at in a browser: the value of ORIGIN on the Heddohon server

http.reason: Send plays to the Heddohon server at the address configured, which is usually on the local network

users.reason: Receive the plays of the users assigned to this plugin

scrobbleRetriever.reason: Read a user's scrobble history when that user asks Heddohon to import it

scheduler.reason: Ask Heddohon every 15 seconds whether an import was requested
